name: Easy Spiced Basmati Pilaf

ingredients.name: cinnamon stick, broken roughly in half

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, heat oil over medium heat until shimmering. Add onion and cook, stirring frequently, until softened and golden brown, about 8 minutes. Stir in sugar. Reduce heat to medium-low and add bay leaves, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, and star anise. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until spices are fragrant, about 5 minutes.

Add fennel seeds and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in rice and season with salt. Cover rice with 1-inch cold water (about 3 cups; 710ml). Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to lowest setting, cover, and cook until water is absorbed and rice is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Serve warm.

description: A mix of fennel seeds, cinnamon, and dry bay leaf perfumes this basmati rice pilaf, releasing a comforting, delicious aroma that lingers long after the dish is done. And even though the recipe itself is simple and quick, its elegance and complex flavor profile impresses my guests without fail.
notes: Optional substitutions: vegetable oil → canola oil
author: Denise D'silva Sankhé
